findings.title: Trigger rising edge during reset is consumed
findings.claim: A trigger rising edge while reset is TRUE may be consumed even though reset suppresses sampling; holding trigger TRUE after reset deasserts then produces no sample. Verify whether reset is intended to dominate sampling or whether this loses a required trigger event.
findings.requirement_basis: “Provide an external trigger signal trigger, which reads a new data value and updates the moving average upon each rising edge.” The reset clause says reset resets the moving average calculation when TRUE but gives no precedence when reset and a trigger edge coincide.
findings.rationale: TriggerRise and PreviousTrigger are updated before the reset branch. The rising edge during reset therefore clears/maintains the reset state without sampling. On the next scan, if trigger stays TRUE, cyclicExecution is FALSE, and reset is FALSE, no new rising edge is present, so the candidate takes no sample. This is an executable probe of unspecified interaction, not a confirmed violation. The assertions capture candidate behavior for adjudication against the intended precedence.
